cost_model: 2 credits per 10 results + 1 credit per scraped page (10) + 1 credit per PDF page = ~12+ credits. USD/credit $0.001-$0.005 by plan (price-table assumption $0.00083 Standard yearly). At $0.003 = $0.036. creditsUsed is authoritative.

docs.supports: one-step scrapeOptions, don't answer from snippets, tbs, credits
full v2 params; query <=500 chars; highlights default true; maxAge 2 days
credits per endpoint; PAYG $/credit by plan

query_transform_notes: Docs: 'Use plain, specific queries.' query max 500 chars; all questions fit. 2026-09 harness sent a separately written keyword_query; current docs do not prescribe keyword rewriting, so verbatim.

rationale.limit: Fixed top-k 10; scraping all 10 gives each result page text (the two-step top-3 variant is FC-S-TOP3).
rationale.scrapeOptions: Docs: one-step search+scrape is 'simpler and faster'; 'Don't summarize from search snippets alone.'
rationale.sources: web only; tbs filters only apply to web.

scrapeOptions.parsers.note: Default parsers ['pdf','image'] parse PDFs at 1 credit/page with no documented page cap in the v2 search reference; our 2026-09 maxPages:3 shape was not re-verified. Watch creditsUsed on PDF-heavy questions.
